tasks.subject: Task 1: Master icon SVG + generated PWA icon assets
tasks.activeForm: Creating master rocket icon SVG and generating PWA icon assets
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Produce every icon file the manifest and HTML head will reference, generated from one hand-authored master SVG.

**Files:**
- Create: `app/assets/icons/rocket-master.svg`
- Create: `pwa-assets.config.ts` (project root)
- Create (generated, committed): `public/favicon.ico`, `public/pwa-64x64.png`, `public/pwa-192x192.png`, `public/pwa-512x512.png`, `public/maskable-icon-512x512.png`, `public/apple-touch-icon-180x180.png`
- Modify: `package.json` (add `@vite-pwa/assets-generator` dev dependency + `generate-pwa-assets` script)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `rocket-master.svg` is valid SVG (512x512 viewBox), navy background, paper nose cone/body, orange fins
- [ ] `npm run generate-pwa-assets` runs successfully and writes all 6 files into `public/`
- [ ] Each generated PNG is a valid image at its expected pixel dimensions (verified via `file`)
- [ ] `favicon.ico` is a valid `.ico` file
- [ ] All generated files committed to git

**Verify:** `npm run generate-pwa-assets && file public/favicon.ico public/pwa-64x64.png public/pwa-192x192.png public/pwa-512x512.png public/maskable-icon-512x512.png public/apple-touch-icon-180x180.png` -> every line reports a valid image at the correct dimensions.

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-23-pwa.md Task 1 for full literal SVG/config content and steps.

tasks.subject: Task 2: Add @vite-pwa/nuxt, configure manifest/service worker, add offline fallback page
tasks.activeForm: Configuring @vite-pwa/nuxt module, manifest, service worker, and offline page
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Wire up the PWA module so the app is installable with a working manifest and service worker, item-data requests are never cached, and a static offline page is shown when a page can't load with no connection.

**Files:**
- Modify: `package.json` (add `@vite-pwa/nuxt` runtime dependency)
- Modify: `nuxt.config.ts`
- Create: `public/offline.html`
- Modify: `.gitignore` (add `dev-dist`)

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds with `@vite-pwa/nuxt` installed and configured
- [ ] Build output includes a generated manifest referencing all 3 icon entries (192, 512, maskable-512), no broken paths
- [ ] Build output includes a generated service worker with a precache manifest covering the app shell
- [ ] `pwa.workbox.runtimeCaching` has `NetworkOnly` rules matching same-origin `/api/*` and any `*.neon.tech` host
- [ ] `public/offline.html` exists as a complete, self-contained static HTML file styled with the navy/paper/orange palette
- [ ] `dev-dist` is present in `.gitignore`

**Verify:** `npm run build && ls .output/public/*.webmanifest .output/public/sw.js` -> both exist; `grep -c "NetworkOnly" nuxt.config.ts` -> `2`.

See docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-23-pwa.md Task 2 for the full literal nuxt.config.ts and offline.html content. Depends on Task 1's generated icon files already existing.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["package.json", "nuxt.config.ts", "public/offline.html", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "npm run typecheck && npm run build && ls .output/public/*.webmanifest .output/public/sw.js", "acceptanceCriteria": ["build succeeds", "manifest references all 3 icons with no broken paths", "service worker precache includes shell assets", "2 NetworkOnly rules present", "offline.html self-contained", "dev-dist gitignored"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Live end-to-end PWA verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Prove, against the real production build served the way it actually ships (via `wrangler dev`, matching the `cloudflare_module` nitro preset), that the app is genuinely installable and that item-data requests are never served from cache.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:** None (verification only; if a real bug is found, fix it in the relevant Task 1/2 file and re-verify).

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `manifest.webmanifest` served, valid JSON matching configured fields, every icon URL returns HTTP 200
- [ ] Service worker registers in a real browser; precache list includes built JS/CSS shell bundles
- [ ] `npx lighthouse` PWA/installability audit passes against the served build
- [ ] App is actually installable: Chrome address-bar install icon works and launches standalone; Safari "Add to Home Screen" produces a working icon
- [ ] After one prior load, simulated offline + reload: app shell still renders (no browser error page); any item-data fetch on that reload visibly fails rather than silently serving stale cache
- [ ] Browser-tab favicon and installed home-screen icon show the same rocket mark, no leftover generic icon anywhere

**Verify:** Real-browser walkthrough per docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-23-pwa.md Task 3 steps 1-6; capture and report actual observations (screenshots or explicit pass/fail per criterion), not inferred results.
